YOUR FIRST CHOICE HVAC AND PLUMBING COMPANY IN NORTH NEW JERSEY

Our specialty at First Choice Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning offers plumbers and HVAC services in North New Jersey.
We ensure your house is comfortable all year round. A failed heater in winter or a broken air conditioner in summer can be stressful and disruptive, and a clogged drain can also upset your daily routine.

Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to providing rapid, dependable, and professional solutions to restore your comfort. Your house deserves the best treatment, so we are here to assist whether you need expert air conditioning services, emergency heating repairs, or a qualified plumber in North New Jersey!

Our Deals
HVAC Repair Service for Better Efficiency

A broken HVAC system can make living unpleasant, whether your house struggles to heat in winter or cool in summer. First Choice Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning offers expert HVAC services to maintain year-round system working efficiency. Our knowledgeable staff addresses everything from analyzing unusual sounds and uneven temperatures to resolving airflow problems and thermostat failures.

We guarantee swift, efficient repairs to restore your comfort quickly and deal with all leading brands. Call us for dependable and competent service you can rely on if your HVAC system isn’t working as it should!

Book Your Appointment Now
Reliable HVAC Replacement Service

If your heating or cooling system continually needs repairs, is antiquated, or is ineffient, it could be time for a replacement. Our company offers professional HVAC replacement, helping homes update to contemporary, energy-efficient systems.

A modern HVAC system increases indoor comfort, decreases energy costs, and lessens the likelihood of unplanned malfunctions. Our staff will evaluate your present system, recommend the finest choices for your home, and precisely install it.

Our Deals
Professional Plumbers in New Jersey

If not quickly fixed, unexpected plumbing issues could cause significant damage. Our knowledgeable North New Jersey plumbers can provide dependable and quick answers to problems such as blocked drains, backed-up sewer lines, or broken water heaters.

Standard Plumbing Issues Homeowners Face
Dripping Faucets and leaky Pipes: Though they might not seem like a significant concern, a small leak can waste gallons of water and, over time, raise electricity expenses.
Slow or Clogged Drains: Clogged drains can cause foul smells and backups regardless of the cause, grease, hair, or foreign items.
Sewer Line Problems: A blocked or damaged sewer line can cause sewage backups within your house, gurgling noises, and delayed drainage.
Low Water Pressure: Weak water flow from your taps could result from a leak, silt accumulation, or central water supply issue.
Burst Pipes: Frozen pipes, particularly in winter, can break and cause significant water damage if not quickly fixed.
Our Deals
Hot Water Heater Repair & Replacement Service

Hot water is required for showering and washing clothing. We identify and fix water heater problems such as leaks and fluctuating temperatures. Our experts also advise upgrading to an energy-efficient model that fits your budget.

We use tank water heaters and tankless systems to find the ideal one for you. Our professional hot water service lets you experience uninterrupted comfort in your house. We find hidden leaks and fix them before they cause extensive damage. Our leak-tracking tools allow us to see the source without tearing down your floors or walls.

Check Our Deals
Clogged Drain & Sewer Cleaning Service 

A clogged drain or backed-up sewer may rapidly become a nightmare, producing bad smells, delayed draining, and possibly even water damage. Our modern tools and established methods guarantee a complete solution for minor kitchen sink clogs, clogged shower drains, or major sewer line backups.
Ignoring drain problems can result in expensive repairs later on, so don’t wait; let our experts effectively clean your drains now to restore appropriate water flow!

Book Your Appointment Now
Reliable Heating Repair Services in New Jersey

A working heating system is vital during cold months. Inefficient boiler or furnace operation can result in lower indoor temperatures, more energy use, and unexpected malfunctions. Our knowledgeable staff guarantees your house stays warm and pleasant by offering heating services in North New Jersey.

Signs You Need Heating Repair or Replacement

Uneven Heating: If some rooms are more remarkable than others, your heating system could not be spreading heat somewhat.
Increased Energy Bills: Rising heating bills usually indicate that your system performs poorly and could require replacement or maintenance.
Unusual Noises: Internal problems in your boiler or furnace may be indicated by banging, rattling, or screeching sounds.
Frequent Cycling: If your furnace cycles on and off often, it may have trouble keeping the specified temperature.
Age of the System: Heating systems usually last ten to fifteen years. Given your age, you may be ready for an update.
Our Deals
Boiler Repair & Replacement Service for Better Indoor Air Quality

First Choice Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning offers knowledgeable boiler repair and replacement services to ensure your house stays warm and healthy. A well-maintaining boiler guarantees constant warmth throughout your house stops dangerous gasses like carbon monoxide from leaking, and improves the air quality.

Our staff is ready to rapidly assess and fix your boiler, whether your problems include uneven heating, unusual noises, or total breakdown. Should repairs prove insufficient, we also provide effective boiler replacement services to guarantee your house continues to be pleasant and your air quality stays safe and healthy. With dependable boiler services, let us maintain your home secure, clean, and warm.

Our Deals
Furnace Repair & Replacement

A malfunctioning furnace can quickly compromise your comfort, particularly in colder months. At First Choice Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning, we specialize in furnace repair services.

We ensure your residence is pleasant even on the coldest days. Our team of experts provides fast, efficient furnace repairs to restore your heating system to maximum performance. We also offer furnace replacement if your furnace is outdated or beyond repair.
We also help you select an energy-efficient model to reduce heating expenses and enhance your home’s comfort. Call us for dependable furnace services that will keep your home warm all winter instead of allowing a broken furnace to leave you freezing!

Get Free Estimate
Top-Tier AC Repair Services in New Jersey

You need quick and dependable service to restore your comfort when your air conditioner breaks down in the middle of a warm summer. First Choice Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning guarantees the effective running of your cooling system when most needed by experienced AC repair service.


Whether your AC is blowing warm air, producing unusual noises, not turning on, or something else entirely, our knowledgeable staff swiftly diagnoses and fixes the problem.


Using cutting-edge tools and high-quality replacement components for long-lasting repairs, we handle all leading brands and models. Don’t let a broken AC cause you to sweat; call us for quick, expert air conditioning repair to have a calm, pleasant home!
